chunks: My father (peace be upon him) narrated from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from al-Hasan al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Uthman, from Isma'il ibn Abi Ubadah, from al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Abu Saeed al-Madaini, who said:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) and said to him, 'May I be your ransom, should I go for the Ziyarat of Husayn (peace be upon him)?' He replied, 'Yes, O Abu Saeed! Go for the Ziyarat of the son of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), for he was the most virtuous among the virtuous, the purest among the pure, and the most righteous among the righteous. If you visit him, Allah will record for you the reward of twenty-two Umrahs.'

key_terms.أَبَرِّ الْأَبَارِ: The most righteous among the righteous
key_terms.أَطْیَبِ الطَّیِّبِینَ: The most virtuous among the virtuous
key_terms.قَبْرَ الْحُسَیْنِ: The grave of Imam Husayn (peace be upon him)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for performing Ziyarat to the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-A’mal*, Abu Saeed al-Madaini seeks confirmation on the virtue of visiting Imam Husayn’s grave, to which Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) responds with high praise, identifying him as the 'most pure of the pure' and 'most righteous of the righteous.' The Imam specifically promises that performing this ziyarat grants the spiritual reward equivalent to twenty-two Umrahs, highlighting the immense merit of visiting the grandson of the Prophet in Shia tradition.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 9.  Abu Saeed Madaini visited Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s.) and asked him, “May I be sacrificed for you, should I go for the Ziyarat  of  Imam  Husain  (a.s.)?”  He  replied,  “Yes,  O  Abu Saeed!  Go  for  Ziyarat  of  the  son  of  Messenger  of  Allah (s.a.w.s.) for he was the most virtuous among virtuous men, purest among pure and best among the doers of good deeds. If you do his Ziyarat Allah would grant you the reward of twenty-two Umrahs.”
